This is the primary replication report with methods, results, Tables 1–3, conclusions and references, not an abstract or secondary excerpt. No PDF was supplied. All five replication locators are p. 4 with blank description and study identifiers. No row-specific target correspondence is established. Page 4 includes female giving-versus-taking (p-value = 0.93), gender within giving (p-value = 0.70), gender within taking (p-value = 0.67), total OLS gender/framing terms, interactions, sex-specific OLS and logistic analyses. Table 1 (p. 3) prints replication Mann-Whitney p = 0.924 (all giving versus taking), 0.725 (male), 0.927 (female), 0.699 (male versus female giving), 0.665 (male versus female taking). Table 2 (p. 5) prints OLS coefficients Giving Game 0.319 and Female 0.259 in first total model; TG*Female 0.497, GG*Male 0.539, GG*Female 0.559 in second total model; Giving Game 0.483 male and 0.071 female. These are printed amount-allocation coefficients, not printed Cohen d; no conversion performed. Table 2 explicit observations are 137 in each total model, 74 male, 63 female. These model Ns remain candidates only because the target is unresolved. Table 1 has 69/68 total, 37/37 male, 32/31 female observations per treatment. No N sum or df derivation performed. Recruitment 274 includes 137 dictators and 137 recipients, and is not substituted for analytic N. No target-specific exclusions established. Table 3 (p. 6) reports distinct logistic analyses of allocating nothing with total/male/female samples. Paper-wide verdict mixed is not a row-specific verdict.
